items.title: Amazon EKS Auto Mode and Karpenter now support Dynamic Resource Allocation
items.summary: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) now supports Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) for NVIDIA GPUs and Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) network devices when using Amazon EKS Auto Mode and Karpenter. You can now define the device attributes your Kubernetes workloads need with DRA, share GPU devices across Pods, and allocate topology-aligned GPU and EFA devices while Amazon EKS Auto Mode and Karpenter dynamically scale Amazon EC2 instances based on workload demand. With DRA, you define ResourceClaim or ResourceClaimTemplate objects that describe what GPU or EFA devices can be allocated to
